description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to amend external elevations and location of substation of planning permission 00108/9-21/P4 dated 24/01/2018 for erection of a part 6 part 11 storey building to include 127 mixed residential units and 1,127m2 of commercial floor space at ground floor level with associated access, highways, car and cycle parking and landscaping
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - This development has commenced within 3 years from the date of the originally approved permission (Ref: 00108/9-21/P4; dated: 24/01/2018).

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (numbered above) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm Mondays to Friday, 8:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays, with no work to take place on Sundays and Bank Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The development shall be built and managed, including all construction works,  in accordance with the approved Construction Management Plan (CMP) and associated approved documents under planning reference 00108/9-21/P4(4) (dated: 21/05/2018) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

The approved documents include:

Received 14/05/2018:
Construction Worker Travel Plan (04/05/18)
Appendix D (Site Logistics & Traffic Management Plan)
Appendix M (Construction Logistics Plan) 

Received 10/05/2018:
Site Setup Procedures (Rev 1.8) 29/08/17 
Vehicle Movements & Programme 

Received 30/04/2018:
Construction Phase Health & Safety Plan (Rev A) 26/04/18 including all appendices

Condition : 5 - The development shall be built in accordance with: 
A.	The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Ground Investigation Report ((no. 14910GI) December 2017) under planning reference 00108/9-21/P4(5AB) (dated: 08/05/2018) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
B.	The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Remediation Statement ((Report 18-149.01: Rev A) March 2018) under planning reference 00108/9-21/P4(5AB) (dated: 08/05/2018) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

During the course of the development:
C.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.

Before the development is first brought into use:
D.	a) The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 7 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved documents listed below approved under planning reference 00108/9-21/P4(7) (dated 18/05/2020) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority:
"	1985-TF-ZZ-01-DR-L-2001 (Play Equipment), received on 20/05/2019 
"	1985-TF-ZZ-01-DR-L-3001(Hard Landscape Plan), received on 20/05/2019 3. 1985-TF-ZZ-01-DR-L-3001 (Hard Landscape Plan), received on 20/05/2019 4. 1985-TF-ZZ-00-DR-L-3001 (Third Floor Detailed Soft Landscape Plan), received on 20/05/2019 
"	1985-TF-ZZ-01-DR-L-3001 (Planting Palette), received on 20/05/2019 
"	EMS156-ABCD-R-201 (External Lighting), received on 20/05/2019 
"	1985-TF-ZZ-00-DR-L-4001 (Sections), received on 20/05/2019 
"	1985-TF-ZZ-00-DR-L-4002 (Sections), received on 20/05/2019 
"	1985-TF-ZZ-01-DR-L-2001 (Hard Landscape Plan), received on 20/05/2019 10. 1985-TF-ZZ-02-DR-L-2002 (Hard Landscape Plan), received on 20/05/2019 
"	1985-TF-ZZ-03-DR-L-2002 (Third Floor Detailed Hard Landscape Plan), received on 20/05/2019 
"	Landscape Design Statement, ref no. 00108/9-21-P4-Condition, received on 20/05/2019 
"	Unnumbered Site Location Plan, received on 20/05/2019 
"	S577-OCSC-XX-XX-DR-C-0702-S2-P01 (Surface Finished Plan), received on 27/01/2020 
"	D2260 L.101 Rev F (General Hard & Soft Arrangement Plan Ground Floor Public Realm), received on 27/01/2020 

All landscaping in accordance with the approved scheme shall be completed / planted during the first planting season following completion of construction works. The submission shall include a management programme for the lifetime of the development.

Any trees or shrubs planted which die within five years of completion of the development shall be replaced with the same species, and of comparable maturity, or an approved alternative. The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.
Condition : 8 - The building shall not be occupied until a means of pedestrian and vehicular access has been constructed in accordance with the approved plans.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the approved drawings, prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, details of all highway works required to secure the 'left in/left out' arrangements at the new Parsonage Road access, relocation of the speed hump on Bell Road, and the permanent closure of all redundant vehicle crossovers with kerbs and footways reinstated shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall be completed prior to first occupation of the development.

Condition : 10 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on the approved drawings shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 11 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved documents listed below approved under planning reference 00108/9-21/P4(11) (dated: 14/06/2018) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority:
"	Dwg. No. 540/P/512 (Typical Cycle Store/Rack Details) - Received 19/04/2018
"	Dwg. No. 540/P511 Rev A (Ground Floor Plan Cycle Stores) - Received 12/06/2018

The spaces shown on the approved drawings shall be available for use before first occupation of the relevant part of the development that use those facilities and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 12 - No part of the development shall be occupied until a Car Park Management Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include but not be restricted to the following:
"	details and location of 20% electric vehicle charging points (min. 7kW) and details of a further 20% passive provision;
"	details of parking layout and allocations (including details as to how the occupancy will be maximised through the lease or sale)
"	details of measures proposed to restrict parking to designated bays only and prohibit parking on the service area
"	details of the roller shutters and/or sliding gates to the Commercial Area Car Park and the Residential Car Park, including how and when they will be operated

The car parking areas shall thereafter be managed in compliance with the approved Car Park Management Plan.

Condition : 13 - No commercial unit shall be occupied until a Delivery and Servicing Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall provide details of how deliveries and servicing will be undertaken within the site, the measures proposed to restrict loading and unloading on the public highway and details of how the roller shutters and/or sliding gates to the Commercial Area Car Park will be operated. All deliveries and servicing of the site shall thereafter be managed in compliance with the approved Delivery & Servicing Plan.
Condition : 14 - Each residential unit shall meet M4(2) Building Regulations as shown on the hereby approved plans.
Condition : 15 - A minimum 10% 'Wheelchair User Dwellings' (13 units) built to Building Regulations M4(3) standard shall be provided.

Condition : 16 - A.	The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved documents listed below approved under planning reference 00108/9-21/P4(16A, 36) (dated: 22/08/2018) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority:
"	Statement for the discharge of planning conditions relating to surface water drainage (Rev P02) by OCSC - Received: 14/06/2018

B.	The building shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 17 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s), evidence shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed with materials that have secured the following sustainability standards:
"	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment's (BRE) 'The Green Guide of Specification'.
"	At least 50% of timber and timber products are sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) schemes.
"	No construction or insulation materials are used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 18 - No part of the development shall be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure and National Calculation Method) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the submitted Energy Statement (dated May 2015) and the details within the Energy Addendum (dated 12th November 2020) and a reduction in C02 emissions has been achieved in accordance with the London Plan policies.

Condition : 19 - The building(s) shall not be occupied until evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority demonstrating that the development has been constructed to achieve an internal water consumption of the development not exceeding 105 lip/day in line with The Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings from the Department of Communities and Local Government.

Condition : 20 - A.	The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved documents listed below approved under planning reference 00108/9-21/P4(20A) (dated: 17/05/2018) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority:
"	Dwg. No. 540/P/510 -  Received: 19/04/2018

B.	The building(s) shall not be occupied until evidence has (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 21 - A.	The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved documents listed below approved under planning reference 00108/9-21/P4(21A) (dated: 08/05/2018) and this application (Ref: 00108/9-21/P4) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority:
"	BREEAM Assessment Credits Report (EMS151) 02/02/2018 - Received 28/03/2018
"	BREEAM Addendum - dated 26/02/2021

B.	Within 3 months of work starting on site, a BREEAM UK New Construction 2014 (or such equivalent standardthat replaces this) Shell/Shell and Core Interim (Design Stage) Certificate, issued by the Building Research Establishment BRE), must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority demonstrating that a minimum 'Excellent' rating will be achieved.

C.	Prior to first occupation of any of the non-residential floorspace, a BREEAM UK New Construction 2014 (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) Shell/Shell and Core Final (Post-Construction) Certificate, issued by the Building Research Establishment (BRE), must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that a minimum 'Excellent' rating has been achieved. All measures integrated shall be retained for as long as the development is in existence.

Condition : 22 - A.	Prior to commencement of the fit-out of the non-residential floorspace, a BREEAM Refurbishment and Fitout 2014 Interim (Design Stage) Certificate, issued by the Building Research Establishment (BRE), must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that a minimum 'Excellent' rating will be achieved.

B.	Within 3 months of first occupation of any of the non-residential floorspace, a BREEAM Refurbishment and Fitout 2014 Final (Post-Construction) Certificate, issued by the Building Research Establishment (BRE), must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that a minimum 'Excellent' rating has been achieved. All measures integrated shall be retained for as long as the development is in existence.

Condition : 23 - Details of any external plant to be installed on the relevant building(s) hereby approved shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to their installation. Such details shall include any necessary sound reduction strategy/mitigation measures. No further fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the written prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 24 - A.	Before any above ground level works are commenced a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from external noise, taking into consideration the recommendations of the Noise Study (Ref: P1902-REP01-TSL P03; dated: 18 December 2020) and the formal response from Sol Acoustics (dated 19th February 2021) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Such a scheme shall include details of measures to ensure any external balconies meet the relevant standards of BS8233. Any works that form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied.

B.	Prior to any part of the development being occupied, sound insulation test reports, demonstrating compliance with the scheme approved under Part A of this condition, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 25 - A.	The use of the ground floor commercial units shall not commence until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airbourne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

B.	Prior to the use of the ground floor commercial units commencing, post-completion testing demonstrating noise levels at the nearest residential receptors will not exceed BS 8233 (good category) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 26 - The ground floor commercial unit(s) shall be only be used for purposes within Classes E (a, b, c (i), c (ii), c (iii), e, d, f, g (i)), F1 and F2 and for no other purpose (including any other purpose within these Use Classes of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 2015, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 27 - Any E(a)/E(g)(i) uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 8:00am to 11:00pm Monday to Saturday, 10:00am to 11:00pm Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 28 - Any E(b) uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 9:00am to 11:00pm Monday to Saturday, 10:00am to 11:00pm Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 29 - Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of residential properties in the locality, in particular the upper levels of this development, in accordance with adopted Local Plan Policy E05.

Condition : 30 - No deliveries to the ground floor commercial unit(s) shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 08:00?19.00 Monday to Saturday, and 10.00?13.00 Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 31 - Full details of the design of the shop front to the ground floor commercial unit(s) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the fit out of the commercial unit(s) hereby approved. The details shall be carried out as approved prior to first occupation of the unit to which the details relate.
Condition : 32 - No amplified music or other music shall be played outside the commercial premises hereby approved.

Condition : 33 - Any Class E(b) use of the ground floor commercial premises shall not commence until a scheme for the control of fumes and odours, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 34 - No part of the development shall be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the submitted Ecology Appraisal and the recommendations have been implemented. Any such measures shall be retained throughout the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 35 - A.	The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved documents listed below approved under planning reference 00108/9-21/P4(35) (dated: 16/04/2018) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority:
"	Archaeological Evaluation Report (Rev 2) dated 25/07/2017 - Received: 26/02/2018

B.	The development shall not be occupied until the site investigation and post investigation assessment has been completed in accordance with the programme set out in the Written Scheme of Investigation approved under Part (A), and the provision for analysis, publication and dissemination of the results and archive deposition has been secured.

Condition : 36 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved documents listed below approved under planning reference 00108/9-21/P4(16A, 36) (dated: 22/08/2018) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority:
"	Statement for the discharge of planning conditions relating to surface water drainage (Rev P02) by OCSC - Received: 14/06/2018

No discharge of foul or surface water from the site shall be accepted into the public system until the drainage works referred to in the strategy have been completed.

Condition : 37 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved documents listed below approved under planning reference 00108/9-21/P4(37) (dated: 15/05/2018) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority:
"	Statement for the discharge of planning conditions relating to impact piling (Project S577) April 2018 by OCSC - Received: 20/04/2018

Any piling must be undertaken in accordance with the terms of the approved piling method statement.

Condition : 38 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved documents listed below approved under planning reference 00108/9-21/P4(38) (dated: 29/05/2018) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority:
"	Bird Hazard Management Plan Rev 29/03/2018 - Received: 09/05/2018

The management plan shall comply with Advice Note 8 Potential Bird Hazard from Building Design. The Bird Hazard Management Plan shall then be implemented in accordance with the approved details on completion of development and shall remain in force for the lifetime of the development.
